sources.entry: Autoposting MCP - MCP server for social content creation, drafts, scheduling and publishing to connected accounts; hosted backend is paid SaaS. #paid #mcp

summary.name: Autoposting.ai
summary.one_liner: Autoposting.ai is a social media automation platform that generates AI-written posts, schedules them, and publishes to connected accounts, with API, CLI and MCP access for developers.
use_cases: Schedule LinkedIn and X posts from a content calendar
Generate on-brand social posts from blog posts or product docs
Publish posts from git commits or CI/CD pipelines
Let an AI agent draft and publish social content via MCP
Manage social accounts for multiple clients or brands
summary.what_it_does: Autoposting.ai generates social media posts with an AI agent that uses a brand knowledge base of uploaded docs, tone guides and product updates. Posts are adapted to each platform's style and can be scheduled for times when the audience is active. A CLI (npm package @autoposting.ai/cli) and a REST API let users create and schedule posts from a terminal or other tools, and the service exposes an MCP integration for AI agents such as Claude. It also offers multi-brand workspaces with roles and permissions, and automatic reposts of selected posts on X at a set interval.
notable: MCP server and REST API for letting AI agents or CI/CD publish posts
Knowledge base that the AI reads before generating content
Auto-repost of selected X posts on a configurable interval
Multi-brand workspaces with team roles and approval flow
caveats: Pricing is credits-based for AI generation; paid tiers (Starter, Pro, Unlimited) exist beyond the free plan
Listing describes the hosted backend as paid SaaS
Full pricing details are on a separate page and were not shown in the page text
